audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N] (which itself matches packet.levelChart): rows 0,1,2,3,4,6 all named the wrong side.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[N] both read [Skill, Jhin, Jhin, Skill, Tristana, Skill, Skill], but the full layer had [Tristana, Tristana, Tristana, Tristana, Skill, Skill, Tristana] — a page rendering two different level charts to the reader.
audit.corrected: Moved every mismatched phases[N].side to agree with win[N] (already correct), rewriting rating and why together wherever the old why contradicted the new verdict.
